final:
class Bad:
    n: int

def check(x: int) -> int fail Bad:
    """Return x when it is even, otherwise fail with Bad(n=x)."""
    ex check(2) == Ok(2)
    ex check(3) == Err(Bad(n=3))
    if x % 2 == 1:
        fail Bad(n=x)
    return x

def all_even(xs: list[int]) -> list[int] fail Bad:
    """Check every element of xs in parallel and return the results in order.

    If any element is odd, fail with the Bad for the lowest-index odd element,
    regardless of which parallel call finishes first.
    """
    post out.len() == xs.len()
    ex all_even([2, 4, 6]) == Ok([2, 4, 6])
    ex all_even([]) == Ok([])
    ex all_even([2, 3, 5]) == Err(Bad(n=3))
    ex all_even([7, 4, 1]) == Err(Bad(n=7))
    vals = par [check(x) else -1 for x in xs]
    out: list[int] = []
    for i in range(xs.len()):
        v = vals[i]
        if v == -1:
            fail Bad(n=xs[i])
        out.append(v)
    return out
